description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) on the x-axis and BLEU score on the y-axis for four different methods evaluated on the WMT15 De dataset. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from 0 to 7 with tick marks at integer intervals (0, 2, 4, 6), and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 12 to 28 with major gridlines at intervals of 2 (12, 14, ..., 28), also on a linear scale. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (purple circles connected by a dashed line) starts at approximately BLEU 13 at AL=0 and rises steadily to about BLEU 26.5 at AL=7. “Inconsistency-CE” (maroon squares, dashed line) begins near BLEU 20 at AL=0 and increases to approximately BLEU 27 at AL=7. “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue squares, dash-dot line) starts around BLEU 20 at AL=0 and climbs to about BLEU 27 at AL=7, closely tracking “Inconsistency-CE.” “Consistency-Bi” (red stars, solid line) begins at BLEU ~22.5 at AL=0 and rises to approximately BLEU 28 at AL=7, consistently outperforming the other methods across the range. All lines show a positive trend, indicating that BLEU scores generally improve as average lagging increases.
